newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's cuts JAL long-term bond rating to A3.
newsitem.headline: Moody's cuts JAL long-term bond rating to A3.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday that it had cut its rating for Japan Airlines Co Ltd's (JAL) long-term unsecured bonds to A3 from A2.

Moody's also said it had lowered the airline's senior unsecured shelf rating to (P)A3 from (P)A2, the counterparty rating to A3 from A2, and the commercial paper rating of JAL's financially supported subsidiary, JAL Capital Corp, to Prime2 from Prime1.

Moody's said the rating was based on its expectation that in spite of a general improvement in the health of the global airline industry, JAL's relatively poor cost structure is likely to continue to adversely affect future profitability.

It said the rating action reflects its concern that competition is increasing both domestically, in the form of gradual deregulation, and internationally, through significant global alliances, which will place further pressure on margins and overall market share.
